capabilities.title: Five everyday jobs it handles for your office
capabilities.subtitle: No complicated software to learn. Just plain answers pulled directly from the documents your business already owns.

items.title: SOPs & Company Handbooks
items.description: New or existing staff can ask questions about daily rules, onboarding steps, or safety checklists and get the exact answer from your manuals.
items.examplePrompt: “What is our step-by-step checklist when a new client signs on?”

items.title: Private File Search
items.description: Find a specific contract clause, a renewal date, or a client note buried inside thousands of Word files and folders in seconds.
items.examplePrompt: “Which supplier contracts renew before the end of next quarter?”

items.title: Generating & Drafting Documents
items.description: Draft client replies, standard letters, meeting summaries, and internal memos written in your own company tone using your past templates.
items.examplePrompt: “Draft a polite payment reminder letter based on our standard template.”

items.title: Reading PDFs & Explaining Invoices
items.description: Drop in a dense 40-page PDF report or a confusing supplier invoice and get a clear, line-by-line explanation of what it says and what you owe.
items.examplePrompt: “Explain this freight invoice in plain words and flag any extra fees.”

items.title: Everyday Office Translation
items.description: Translate emails, contracts, and staff manuals between languages accurately while keeping your company’s exact terms consistent.
items.examplePrompt: “Translate this service agreement into German and keep our legal terms.”

example.title: See how it works on real office paperwork
example.subtitle: Click any of the three everyday questions below. Every answer shows the exact document and page it came from so you can verify it yourself.

samples.question: Can you explain this supplier invoice and tell me why it is higher than last month?
samples.answer:
This invoice totals $4,280.00 (due November 30). It is $640.00 higher than September’s bill for two reasons:

1. Express Pallet Delivery ($490.00) was added on October 14 for Order #8821.
2. Storage Overrun Fee ($150.00) was charged because 3 pallets stayed past the 14-day free window.

All base unit prices match your 2026 signed rate sheet.

samples.question: What is our company SOP if a customer reports a damaged delivery?
samples.answer:
According to your Operations Manual, follow these three steps within 24 hours:

1. Ask the customer for two photos of the outer box and damaged item before discarding packaging.
2. Issue a replacement order immediately using code REPL-01 (no manager approval needed under $500).
3. Log the carrier tracking number in the Friday Claims Sheet.

samples.question: Translate our standard warranty confirmation letter into German for our Munich client.

hiermit bestätigen wir, dass für Ihre Lieferung vom 12. Oktober unsere standardmäßige 24-monatige Herstellergarantie gilt. Alle Wartungsarbeiten werden direkt über unser Service-Team abgewickelt.
